seo.title: adidas: AI-driven audience prospecting and bidding with Criteo - ROAS +81% in mid-funnel (2023)
seo.meta_description: adidas expanded its MENA acquisition with Criteo (AI prospecting + ARO): ROAS +81% in mid-funnel, +66% in lower funnel over a five-month campaign.
seo.resume_citable: adidas expanded its acquisition beyond social and search across MENA markets with Criteo (AI audience prospecting and Adaptive Revenue Optimization) and reports ROAS up 81% in mid-funnel and 66% in lower funnel over five months.

faq.q: What does Criteo's AI do in this case?
faq.a: It prospects new audiences and sets bids at cost per click against a ROI target (Adaptive Revenue Optimization), optimizing toward web conversions rather than simple visits.

faq.q: Which markets did the case run in?
faq.a: In the Middle East and North Africa: Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Egypt, beyond the social and search channels adidas already used.

pattern: AI-driven audience prospecting and bidding (ARO) across the full funnel
objectif_business: Broaden acquisition beyond social and search in MENA markets, letting Criteo's AI prospect new audiences and set bids against a ROAS target.
description: adidas extended its digital acquisition to the Middle East and North Africa with Criteo, beyond social and search channels. The setup combines AI-driven audience prospecting, dynamic retargeting, and the Adaptive Revenue Optimization (ARO) engine, which sets bids at cost per click against the ROI target and optimizes toward web conversions rather than simple visits. Over a five-month campaign, adidas reports ROAS up 81 percent on mid-funnel campaigns and 66 percent in the lower funnel. Lower-funnel ROI rose from 1.25 in January to 2.08 in May. This is a case of optimizing and automating media buying: the AI arbitrates bids and audiences, it does not produce the creative.

fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The web conversion (purchase) and the ROI target, against which ARO sets bids at cost per click. Without tracked conversions, optimization falls back on visits and loses value.

statut_vivant.note: Criteo's AI bidding setup remains standard and active. The public quantified evidence covers a 2023 campaign; the case is redistributed by Criteo but without more recent verified data for adidas MENA.

transposable_ue.note: Criteo and its bidding engines (Smart Bidding, ARO) operate in Europe. Retargeting and prospecting rely on browsing signals; real GDPR exposure, to be managed through consent and scope of collection. The case also shows the transposability from one market to another (MENA here).
